description: Save text as a new file in your Besidka library and return its id. It counts against your storage quota and expires like an upload. The text is not screened for prompt injection, unlike project notes. To give a project the text as knowledge, use add_project_text instead. Requires signing in (files:write).

name.description: File name with its extension, for example report.md

text.description: Plain text, markdown or CSV, up to 200000 characters

name: create_file
title: Create a text file
